basic_info.description: Welcome to 658 30th Ave a charming Mediterranean-style home nestled in San Francisco’s desirable Outer Richmond. Surrounded by classic architecture and wide, peaceful streets, this residence places you near the best of the city: Golden Gate Park, Baker Beach, Lands End, the Presidio, and the iconic Golden Gate Bridge all just minutes away. Step inside to find elegant arched entryways, a bright sunroom, and a formal living and dining area with timeless character. Large windows invite natural light and showcase views of the city by day and vibrant sunsets by night. The home has been thoughtfully curated by the seller, but offers abundant potential for the next owner. Add your personal touch to the kitchen, bathrooms, and expansive backyard to create something truly special. With a school right across the street and access to top-rated SFUSD options nearby, this location is both practical and inspiring. The home’s central position offers easy access to shopping, dining, outdoor adventures, and transit. Whether you’re a lover of San Francisco’s westside charm or simply looking for a value add opportunity in a premier neighborhood, this home is one you won’t want to miss.
